Comment: Enable Datadog systemd health checks for SMIOT server services

commands:
cat > /etc/datadog-agent/conf.d/systemd.d/conf.yaml <<'DDSYSTEMD'
init_config:
instances:
  - unit_names:
      - smiot.service
      - mongod.service
      - mosquitto.service
      - nginx.service
      - wokwi-bridge.service
      - datadog-agent.service
DDSYSTEMD
